name: tlc
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && python3 -m pip install -q --target /tmp/track-m-tlcdeps modal && mkdir -p /src && ln -sfn "$PWD" /src/gdp-wired && PYTHONPATH=/tmp/track-m-tlcdeps python3 -c 'import json; from research.protocols.ic3syn.tlc import one; print(json.dumps(one.local("mldr", 180000)))'

name: check
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun run check && bun test core/field-laws.test.ts
